packageRules.description: Group and automerge non-breaking npm updates
Group and automerge non-breaking NuGet updates
Group and automerge GitHub Actions updates

Renovate cannot enumerate tags for this image and reports 'no-result' on every run, which parks a warning at the top of the dependency dashboard. The sibling mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/sdk and /aspnet images resolve fine, so this is an upstream lookup quirk rather than a bad reference. Pinned by hand alongside those two when the .NET major changes.
